iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 5 midday pulse: AP/IAEA reporting says inspectors still lack access to struck Iranian facilities and cannot verify enrichment status, stockpile size, or observed activity at Natanz and Fordow. Reuters reports the Hormuz-first proposal would postpone the atomic file and was rejected by Trump. Risk rises through inspection blackout plus Iran-war coupling. Probability 61%. Rising/imminent.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: May 5 midday pulse: Guardian live coverage reports US Project Freedom escort operations through Hormuz, US firing on and sinking six Iranian small boats per US claims, two US-flagged merchant ships transiting under escort, Iranian threats against US vessels, and Iranian missile/drone attacks on UAE/Fujairah oil facilities. Direct US-Iran maritime contact risk is acute. Probability 88%. Rising/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 5 midday pulse: latest high-quality Lebanon items still show an ineffective ceasefire with Israeli raids in southern Lebanon, building demolitions, Hezbollah statements preserving a right to retaliate, and Netanyahu reserving freedom of action. No newer decisive break since prior scan, so level remains extreme but not accelerating. Probability 84%. Stable/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: May 5 midday pulse: search shows Turkey primarily as a NATO mediation/alliance node, including Erdogan trying to revive Russia-Ukraine negotiations and older NATO Iraq adjustments. No fresh Turkish kinetic trigger surfaced. Probability 15%. Falling/elevated.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: May 5 midday pulse: India-Pakistan search remains dominated by stale 2025 Kashmir crisis articles and pullback coverage. No fresh mobilization, cross-border strike, or official atomic-weapons threat surfaced. Probability 8%. Stable/deterrent.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: May 5 midday pulse: Reuters/NATO nuclear posture critique remains the main active signal; no new Russian alert posture shift or direct Article 5 trigger found. Coupling from Ukraine deep-strike cycle keeps this critical. Probability 37%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China
china.notes: May 5 midday pulse: Reuters China-Taiwan results emphasize Beijing rejecting US pressure claims, prior drills, and China maintaining force-option language while also messaging peaceful reunification through KMT channels. No fresh blockade trigger. Probability 52%. Falling/imminent.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 5 midday pulse: searches did not surface a fresh DPRK launch or atomic detonation event; current references remain residual from prior projectile activity and warhead claims. Signal decays. Probability 34%. Falling/critical.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 5 midday pulse: search continues to show widening strike-counterstrike depth, including Ukraine attacks on Russian oil infrastructure far from the front and only a short Victory Day pause proposal treated skeptically by Kyiv. Escalation remains broad but not a step-change from morning. Probability 63%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 5 midday pulse: no confirmed fresh 24h Pakistan-Afghanistan border clash in high-quality search. Residual border-war risk remains but decays absent new contact. Probability 23%. Falling/elevated.
